🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Market shows mixed signals with SPY (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND (stocks and bonds both rallying), while VXX falling (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND suggests lower fear but no clear directional bias.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX falling (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND. Credit/carry neutral-to-supportive: HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND showing stability. Stocks vs bonds neutral: SPY (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND alongside TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: UUP (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL and yield signals muted as TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND indicates bond demand; real yield direction mixed — overall financial conditions steady but watch for shifts.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech and semis leading: XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND showing strong momentum. Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND; style: Growth/momentum leading given confirmed XLK and broad cyclical strength in XLI/XLF proxies.

5. US vs Global?
US slightly stronger: SPY (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +2.36%) ABOVE TREND. EM rebound notable: EEM (1W: +6.58% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — regional bifurcation.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Spec risk-on patches: ARKK (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +5.34%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +5.29%) ABOVE TREND. Crypto mixed: IBIT (1W: +3.65% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY — short-term bounce inside longer weakness.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Copper strength: CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.62%) ABOVE TREND signaling industrial demand. Gold recovering: GLD (1W: +3.74% | 1M: -7.13%) RECOVERY — safe-haven buying amid rotating risk.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy weak: XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND and Brent BNO (1W: -15.49% | 1M: -24.56%) BELOW TREND — clear commodity-driven drag; natural gas UNG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND but flat.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +8.18% | 1M: +9.18%) ABOVE TREND show coherent growth leadership. Divergence: commodities and oil (BNO/USO) materially BELOW TREND while metals (GLD/SLV) in RECOVERY — minor-to-moderate divergences that keep regime neutral.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclical growth exposure such as XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND and industrial/financial proxies (XLI/XLF proxies showing sector strength). Reduce exposure to energy ETFs like XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND and monitor commodity downside.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Semis/S&P tech — SOXX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy — XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -15.49% | 1M: -24.56%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.62%) ABOVE TREND for industrial demand signals. BEARISH: Oil BNO (1W: -15.49% | 1M: -24.56%) BELOW TREND and USO (1W: -14.94% | 1M: -23.48%) BELOW TREND for downside pressure.

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND — watch for complacency if it stays low. HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND — credit health check. XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND vs XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND — tech/energy divergence.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL — Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed signals with both equities (SPY (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND) and bonds (TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND) rallying. Technology and semiconductors showing relative strength (XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk is commodity/energy collapse versus metals/tech strength — monitor oil ETFs (BNO/USO) and GLD/SLV divergences.
